title: State and Local Probation and Parole Systems, 1976
description:
This study is a census of all state and local probation and
 parole systems. It was conducted in late 1976 by the United States
 Census Bureau for the Bureau of Justice Statistics. The data contain
 information on each agency, including jurisdiction, funding and
operation, employment, and client caseload.
